propositions: Offline mapping-config validation must surface load-time errors (non-integer hierarchy, malformed blocks) and resolve-time errors (out-of-vocabulary, unmapped-non-skipped values) as error findings, and all-empty project blocks as warning findings, without importing jira adapters.

Live-drift checks must degrade gracefully to an unavailable finding when jira-datacenter extra is absent, credentials unset, settings resolution fails, or probe times out, never raising or blocking doctor success.
Mapping findings must be tracked in their own list separate from scan-dirty/lock reports, rendered and folded into exit code, but kept out of run_repair's blocking-edge contract.
Live-drift detection via injected probe reader must identify configured-vs-observed divergences on status, type, and link axes per project, excluding hierarchy which is undetectable in Data Center.
Doctor-side probe timeout must be bounded by a module constant (default 10s) with result(timeout=...) to prevent hanging, abandoning timed-out threads and returning unavailable promptly.

Offline checks must enumerate config.projects union the default layer and run provider-neutral resolvers (effective_status_map, effective_type_map, effective_link_map, assert_type_decisions_complete) to catch all configuration errors without live dependencies.
